ambiguities_or_notes: The syntactically unusual ‘мечте позабытой души’ is kept conservatively as ‘the dream of a forgotten soul’ rather than silently recast as a dream forgotten by the soul.
The repeated verb in ‘said ... to say what was said’ is preserved because the repetition belongs to the poem's thought, not treated as English redundancy.
The source's literal angle brackets surrounding the twelve-line passage are preserved as escaped angle brackets in English.
